patterns.rule: When multiple SSH keys exist, use the specific key (id_ed25519_sentinel) instead of default (google_compute_engine). SSH config overrides may not work.
To update systemd service: sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/service.service > /dev/null << 'EOF' ... EOF, then sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart service
x402 mainnet requires AETHERIUS_NETWORK=eip155:8453 (Base Mainnet), not eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia). Service must set both X402_MODE=real and AETHERIUS_NETWORK.
Telegram API requires UTF-8 encoding. Remove emoji and special characters from message text. Use plain text without HTML parse_mode if emoji causes issues.

learnings.text: SSH key for VM sentinel-v4 is id_ed25519_sentinel, not google_compute_engine. The SSH config file points to wrong key.
x402 SDK v2.21.0 already installed in VM venv. No need to reinstall.
Service uses venv at /opt/aetherapi/venv/bin/python, not system python.
Telegram bot token works for posting to channel. Use plain text without HTML for emoji compatibility.

decisions.question: How to deploy to mainnet when SSH config points to wrong key?
decisions.answer: Use specific key file: ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_sentinel instead of relying on SSH config.
decisions.rationale: SSH config was using google_compute_engine key which was denied. id_ed25519_sentinel works.

decisions.question: What network ID for Base Mainnet?
decisions.answer: eip155:8453 (not eip155:84532 which is Base Sepolia testnet).
decisions.rationale: x402 protocol requires correct chain ID for on-chain verification.
